# Borobudur Temple Tour

> Borobudur Temple Tour (https://borobudurtempletour.org/) is an independent guide to visiting and climbing Borobudur, a 9th-century Mahayana Buddhist temple in Magelang Regency, Central Java, Indonesia. It is written with Dewi Lestari, a Borobudur temple tour guide and cultural heritage specialist who has guided more than 1,000 international travellers since 2022. The site compares three real tours from Yogyakarta and routes bookings to the operators' official GetYourGuide and Viator listings through disclosed affiliate links. It is not the temple's operator, not the ticketing authority, and not a tour operator itself.

Key facts: Borobudur is the world's largest Buddhist temple, a UNESCO World Heritage site, about one hour northwest of Yogyakarta, with 1,460 narrative relief panels. The structure climb runs every day from 08:30 to 17:00; the grounds are open 06:30 to 16:30; Monday closures ended in July 2025. The climb ticket includes a guide, a wristband, and mandatory Upanat sandals, kept as a souvenir. The domestic climb ticket is IDR 150,000; the foreign climb price is shown only in the official booking flow. The grounds-only ticket is domestic-only. The official 04:00 sunrise product on the monument costs IDR 1,000,000 international and IDR 750,000 domestic, is capped at 100 people per day, and includes a flashlight, Upanat sandals, a guide, and breakfast at Manohara. No official daily quota exists for the ordinary climb, and no official general dress code exists. Tours that advertise "sunrise" mean Punthuk Setumbu, a hill about 2.5 km from the monument, not the temple itself.

## Tours

- [All Borobudur tours](https://borobudurtempletour.org/tours/): The three featured tours from Yogyakarta, most booked first. All climb the monument, all include Prambanan and hotel pickup.
- [Borobudur Sunrise Climb & Prambanan](https://borobudurtempletour.org/tours/borobudur-sunrise-climb-prambanan/): GetYourGuide, rated 4.9 from 1,682 reviews. Punthuk Setumbu sunrise, guaranteed climb, Prambanan.
- [Borobudur Sunrise, Merapi & Prambanan](https://borobudurtempletour.org/tours/borobudur-sunrise-merapi-prambanan/): Viator, rated 4.9 from about 1,095 reviews, roughly 12 hours. Adds a Mount Merapi jeep ride.
- [Borobudur Climb & Prambanan Day Tour](https://borobudurtempletour.org/tours/borobudur-climb-prambanan-day-tour/): Viator, rated 4.9 from 672 reviews, roughly 8 hours. Daytime start, no sunrise leg.
- [Compare the tours](https://borobudurtempletour.org/compare/): A verdict by visitor type across the three tours.

- [What to wear at Borobudur](https://borobudurtempletour.org/guides/what-to-wear-at-borobudur/): The Upanat sandal rule and the dress-code question.
